SELECT ni.published_at, ni.created_at, na.wirkung_staerke, na.relevant
FROM trading.news_assessments na JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = na.news_id;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (workflow_name) workflow_name, finished_at
FROM trading.pipeline_runs WHERE status = 'success' ORDER BY workflow_name, finished_at DESC;

nodes.name: DB: Letzter erfolgreicher Lauf je Workflow

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent_name) agent_name, model_name, prompt_version, status, started_at, confidence
FROM trading.agent_runs ORDER BY agent_name, started_at DESC;
SELECT status, count(*) AS anzahl FROM trading.news_items GROUP BY status;

SELECT status, count(*) AS anzahl,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE confounded) AS confounded_anzahl,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct = TRUE) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS trefferquote
FROM trading.news_impact_tracking GROUP BY status;

SELECT count(*) AS offene_vorschlaege, max(created_at) AS letzter_vorschlag_am
FROM trading.learning_rule_proposals WHERE status = 'proposed';

SELECT source AS value, count(*) AS sample_size,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct = TRUE) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction_correct IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS trefferquote
FROM trading.news_impact_tracking
WHERE status = 'completed' AND confounded = FALSE AND source IS NOT NULL
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY source ORDER BY sample_size DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT config_key, value_bool, value_text, value_numeric, description, updated_at FROM trading.pipeline_config ORDER BY config_key;
